comment: Stevenson is a really nice guy but his grading system is very unpredictable. Fun class and discussions but hard and a lot of work. Pay attention in class and the tests won't be bad
Great teacher great class. Take this if you are looking to take Latin.

Dr. Stevenson is a really great professor who cares about his students. The readings are a bit much, but the tests are easy if you pay attention. He does a lot of group discussions and encourages the use of AI to study. He's hilarious and is just a smart, funny old guy who knows a lot about his field and has been doing this for a long time.

Very discussion based course which I thought was helpful and engaging. Walt is definitely charismatic and well liked. Make sure to actually do the readings in full not just cherry pick for a discussion question, or it will come back to bite you for the exams.

Dr. Stevenson is compassionate, intelligent, and has a great sense of humor. I always look forward to opening his emails—he has a hilariously dry tone that makes me want to save any mundane email and read it again on a rainy day. He gives lots of work but doesn't grade harshly, and it's easy to learn what to expect. Lots of reading, but worth it.

Professor Stevenson is fun and engaging, his class overall is interesting and insightful. Though I will say that this class, which is a gen ed, required roughly 3x the amount of work than any other class in my career at UR. There are a lot of assignments and quizzes that I think surpass what is necessary to fulfill a general education credit.

The beginning of the semester was difficult because expectations for assignments weren't super clear; however, once you understand what Dr. Stevenson is looking for in an assignment, the class becomes routine and easy. It is not hard to be successful in this class, and if you are struggling, there are plenty of opportunities to improve your grade.

Stevenson was easily my favorite professor this semester. He's engaging and funny during class, and has very high expectations. There is a substantial amount of work, but he is a really, really lenient grader. I learned more Latin in this one semester than I did all 4 years of high school. If you just try your best your grade will be fine.
Great professor and teaches an interesting class. Would def take another of his classes. Graded pretty evenly amongst two exams and a paper and participation, and overall easy and engaging to learn.

Thus far, one of my favorite profs. Has had a huge hand in helping me choose a degree, and he really cares about you doing well in his classes. Classes are always interesting, with the discussion usually being led by students, which makes for fun interactions. Great guy to take for history courses!
The man is a hero. Visiting student last year. By far and away the most enjoyable two courses I took. Light years ahead of the rest. Bravo

Overall this guy is a pretty laid back professor. Still, you have to do the work and the readings but if you do you'll learn a good amount plus its pretty interesting. Also, he made me laugh quite often and who doesn't want a teacher that can make him or her laugh right?

The absolute man. I botched my class project but was able to talk with him and figure out what needed to be done to get an A in the class. Went and spoke to him a few times then crushed the final exam. I'm taking another class with Stevenson next year and can't wait

Prof. Stevenson makes this class compelling and interesting! However, it won't be  easy. One of my most difficult classes this semester, but if you work for it you'll be rewarded with good grades. His assignments for papers can sometimes be confusing, but if you make sure to clarify with him what he's looking for, then you'll do well.

This is the best professor at the UofR. Class discussion is extremely laid back and he is very funny. I took him b/c I needed a class outside the bschool and ended up taking 3 straight courses with him and declaring a minor in history. I highly recommend him.  If you come to class prepared and participate, it is not hard to do well in his class.

Stevenson is absolutely fantastic -- hilarious guy. He has wide knowledge of literature, philosophy, history, film, as well as a lot of practical experience travelling and doing manual labour... Rare in a classicist, and much appreciated. If he can justify giving you an A, he will. Very kind, and always looks for the best in his students.
Prof. Stevenson is an awesome teacher. Class discussion is very relaxed, and very interesting. He really knows his stuff, but lets you determine your own opinion too. I definitely recommend him!

i had walt for an FYS and it was pretty chill. the guy is a fair grader and is straightforward with what he wants in the assignments. He likes to make sexual jokes which keeps the class entertaining but overall it wasnt that bad. a pretty cool dude
Walt is the man. Turned a class about Greek and Roman rhetoric into something very interesting. Plus, he is hilarious.

Great, great professor for Roman History. Class is lecture style, and has students start most conversations to base his lecture on. The class is unbelievably interesting- Dr. Stevenson is always helpful, and has an awesome sense of humor. Grading is extremely fair; highly recommend this course!
Great teacher overall. He makes the class entertaining. i would definitely take him for ROman history.
He's really, really hard. He ruined my gpa and I worked hard even though I'm not a Latin All-star.

Very good teacher. Helpful, interesting, and funny guy. I only took the course as a history requirement and I ended up truely enjoying the course. There needs to be more professors like him at Richmond.

i love this man. i've taken 2 classes with him, and can't wait til he gets back from sabbatical so i can take more. he is incredibly smart, makes lectures interesting, and is very laid-back. he's not an easy grader, and you'll have to read before each class, but it's worth it- i learned so much!
great teacher.  keeps you entertained and explains the latin very well.  i highly recommend him.
Stevenson is absolutely great.  Take every class you can get with him.  Fair grader, very interesting in class, and always willing to help.  Super professor.
Class is so interesting.  He is so helpful and funny and always willing to help you.
